## The Turducken of Desserts, Explained for Thanksgiving 2026


PieCaken Bakeshop’s Original PieCaken


## **What is PieCaken?**


A PieCaken is a layered dessert that stacks pie and cake into one. The Original PieCaken has pecan pie on the bottom, pumpkin pie in the middle, and spice cake on top. The layers are held together with cinnamon buttercream and crowned with apple pie filling. Pastry chef Zac Young created it in 2015 as the dessert version of a turducken. It’s now one of the most famous Thanksgiving desserts in America.


If you can never decide which dessert to have at Thanksgiving, the PieCaken settles it: every slice gets three.


**PieCaken at a glance**


- **What it is:** pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake stacked with cinnamon buttercream and topped with apple pie filling
- **Who created it:** pastry chef Zac Young, with pastry chef Gian Martinez, in New York City
- **When:** Thanksgiving 2015
- **Inspired by:** the turducken, a turkey stuffed with a duck stuffed with a chicken
- **Size:** about 6 pounds, serves 10–12
- **When it’s served:** Thanksgiving, plus seasonal versions for Christmas, Valentine’s Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Passover, and the Fourth of July

## **What’s inside a PieCaken?**


The Original PieCaken has three dessert layers, bottom to top:


1. **Pecan pie:** gooey, buttery, and crunchy with toasted pecans
2. **Pumpkin pie:** creamy and lightly spiced with cinnamon, ginger, and allspice
3. **Spice cake:** soft, warm cake with cinnamon and allspice


Cinnamon buttercream binds the layers and covers the cake, and apple pie filling is spooned over the top. Every slice gets crunchy, creamy, and fluffy textures, along with nearly every classic Thanksgiving dessert flavor.


## **Who invented the PieCaken?**


Zac Young created the PieCaken in 2015, while he was pastry director for the David Burke restaurant group in New York. He and pastry chef Gian Martinez were brainstorming Thanksgiving specials for David Burke Fabrick, a restaurant in Midtown Manhattan. Their goal was to make the turducken of desserts, served by the slice.


Then Young posted an in-progress photo on Instagram about a week and a half before Thanksgiving. Followers wanted whole cakes, not slices. Young quickly built a website to take orders and sold around 500 PieCakens that week. The PieCaken landed on *Live with Kelly and Michael* and in *The New York Times* . By 2016, Young was shipping PieCakens nationwide.


Today the PieCaken is made by Young’s PieCaken Bakeshop and ships nationwide on Goldbelly.


Young said in 2025 “Ten years ago, I posted an in-progress picture of an ultimate thanksgiving dessert special we were doing for a restaurant,” Young reminisced. “My friends responded that they would like the whole cake for their celebration. ‘We don’t sell cakes!’ was my first response before quickly figuring out how to sell cakes out of the restaurant basement. In the decade since, I never imagined The PieCaken would become such a viral sensation and beloved holiday tradition. I’m so thankful for ten incredible years of sharing this dessert wonder with tables across the country through Goldbelly.”


## **** **What Does PieCaken taste like?**


The dessert tastes like pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake — all together at once! The gooey pecan pie is crunchy, nutty, and buttery.


The pumpkin is sweet and creamy with a hint of cinnamon, ginger, and allspice. The spice cake tastes similar with its warm, aromatic spice flavors like cinnamon and allspice. The apple pie filling with diced apples is sweet and tart.


This dessert tastes like all our favorite desserts, pie, cake, and frosting, at the same time. It’s a burst of sweet flavors and textures, crunchy, soft, and creamy. It tastes like nothing you have ever had before.


## **** **** **Is the PieCaken the first pie-in-a-cake dessert?**


No, but it’s the most famous. A few years earlier, entertainer Charles Phoenix created the **Cherpumple** : cherry, pumpkin, and apple pies baked inside three layers of cake. The PieCaken took the idea in a different direction. Instead of baking pies inside cake, it stacks whole layers of pie and cake on top of each other.


## **** **** **What are the different kinds of PieCaken?**


Zac Young releases limited-edition PieCakens for holidays throughout the year. Each one has three dessert layers. Versions have included:


- **[The Original PieCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-piecaken) (Thanksgiving):** pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake with cinnamon buttercream and apple pie filling
- **The Christmas PieCaken:** chocolate pecan pie, cherry swirl cheesecake, and red velvet cake with cream cheese buttercream and festive sprinkles
- **[The Red Velvet PieCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/valentines-day-piecaken) (Valentine’s Day):** chocolate pecan pie, cherry swirl cheesecake, and red velvet cake with cream cheese buttercream
- **[The St. PatCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-st-patcaken) (St. Patrick’s Day):** whiskey pecan pie, Baileys cheesecake, and Guinness green velvet cake with salted caramel frosting
- **[The PassCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-passcaken) (Passover):** matzo-crusted coconut macaroon pie, flourless chocolate cake, and raspberry mousse, made with Kosher for Passover ingredients
- **[The Red, White & Blueberry PieCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/red-white-and-blue-piecaken) (Fourth of July):** wild Maine blueberry pie, New York cheesecake, and red velvet cake with lemon frosting
- **[The DecaCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-10-year-anniversary-decacaken) :** a 10th-anniversary edition twice the size of the original, with ten components including butterscotch brown butter blondie, chocolate cream pie, coffee cake, and cheesecake

## **PieCaken FAQ** s


**How many people does a PieCaken serve?**


The Original PieCaken weighs about 6 pounds and serves 10–12. The DecaCaken serves 20–24.


**How much does a PieCaken cost?**


The Original PieCaken is $109.95 on Goldbelly.


**Can you freeze a PieCaken?**


Yes. PieCakens ship frozen and can be kept in the freezer for up to three months.


**Why is it called a PieCaken?**


The name combines “pie” and “cake” and nods to the turducken, the Thanksgiving dish of a chicken inside a duck inside a turkey.
